Package game.gameUtils

Class BoardManager

java.lang.Object
game.gameUtils.BoardManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BoardManager extends Object implements Serializable
This class manages the game board, including cell movements, merging, and checking game state.

Maksym Kulynych
